Package it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.preLobby

package it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.preLobby
Houses the server-side model for the pre-lobby phase.

Contains the business logic and domain types that handle clients after they connect but before they enter a lobby or a match, covering authentication, lobby listing, and lobby creation and joining checks.
